text: PBOC's Pan told the NPC Standing Committee the report reviewed financial work since Oct 2025 and assessed current economic and financial challenges. He said the central bank will continue to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to support sustained, higher-quality growth;
text_zh: 央行行长潘功胜向全国人大常委会表示，报告回顾了2025年10月以来的金融工作，并评估了当前经济和金融挑战。他表示，央行将继续实施适度宽松的货币政策，以支持持续、更高质量的增长；
